notes: Account overview: mid-to-large contact center platform providing omnichannel routing + agent desktop. Interested in adding real-time agent assist and automated ticket summarization.
Primary DM: Lara Chen, VP Engineering — cares about deterministic latency, observability, and guardrails for outbound messages.

Requirements summary: streaming suggestions to agent UI, <150ms p95 for suggestion tokens at 50 concurrent agents, graceful degradation during 3-4x traffic spikes, integration with Zendesk + internal CRM for tool-calls.
Security: must support VPC peering, customer-managed KMS, SOC2 report and per-token audit logs; EU data residency required for subset of customers.
POC scope (signed SOW): 3-week perf/quality POC, 50-agent simulation, compare Redwood dedicated vs baseline self-hosted stack, evaluate Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization.

Notes from call: 'If suggestions are slow or wrong, agents will ignore them — quality + latency are equally critical' — Lara.

Integration notes: tool-calling needs constrained actions only (open ticket, attach KB article, escalate to supervisor). They want explicit allowlist for tool actions and audit trail for each tool-call.
Spike behavior: 4x traffic during promos/holidays; they expect autoscaling but need predictable tail-latency and a fallback policy to degrade to text-only prompts vs streaming when overloaded.
Acceptance criteria for POC: p95 latency <150ms for suggestions at target concurrency OR graceful degrade with no incorrect tool-calls; end-to-end demo with live agents and Zendesk updates.
Open questions: network egress path (NAT vs PrivateLink), encryption at rest for cache, retention window for audit logs, can Redwood guarantee per-route QoS?
